title: Hi, I'm Linh!
summary_vi: Bạn sẽ luyện giới thiệu bản thân: tên, tuổi, nơi ở và sở thích.
sentences: Hello, my name is Linh.
I am twenty years old.
I live in Hanoi with my family.
I am a student at a big university.
I like music and I love coffee.
Every day, I study English for one hour.
I want to make new friends.
Nice to meet you!

vocabulary.example: What is your name?
My brother is ten years old.
They live in a small town.
She is a good student.
His university is near the river.
I play games with my friends.

questions.explanation_vi: Cô ấy nói: I want to make new friends.

sentences: This is my family.
My father is a teacher.
My mother works in a small shop.
I have one sister and one brother.
My sister is ten years old.
My brother plays football every day.
We eat dinner together at seven.
I love my family very much.

vocabulary.example: Her family is very friendly.
My father drives a red car.
His mother makes great soup.

Her brother has a new bike.

questions.explanation_vi: Cả nhà ăn tối cùng nhau lúc bảy giờ.

title: Emma Is Lost

sentences: Emma is lost in Hanoi.

The lake is near the school.
Emma says thank you and smiles.

vocabulary.example: I am lost in this big city.

The bank opens at eight.

The cafe is next to the library.
My house is near the station.
